text.p: Grantchester Holdings Plc said on Thursday it was making several acquisitions to increase its retail warehouse portfolio and plans a rights issue to raise 65 million stg.
Among the acquisitions, it plans to buy a portfolio of up to seven retail warehouses from J. Sainbury Developments Ltd, part of British supermarket group J.Sainsbury Plc, for around 73.3 million stg.
The acquisitions will, if successfully completed, treble Grantchester's retail warehouse portfolio since its flotation just over four months ago.
"These transactions will give Grantchester a substantial presence in one of the fastest growing sectors of the property market," said Paul Whight, chairman of Grantchester.
The company also plans to buy two retail warehouse schemes in Scotland which will be developed by Morrison Construction Group Plc for an expected 23.1 million stg.
It also said it will exercise its options the Leeds Road Retail Park, Huddersfield for not more than 16.15 million.
Burford Holdings Plc, which holds around 24 percent of the issued share capital of Grantchester, is the owner of the Huddersfield property.
Grantchester will also purchase a retail warehouse scheme in Middlesbrough for 9.25 million.

It said it will finance the agreement with Sainsbury to acquire the Sainsbury portfolio, which will comprise 394,000 square feet of retail space, partly with a 7 for 10 rights issue of up to 49 million new ordinary shares at 137p per share to raise around 65.0 million stg.
Barclays de Zoete Wedd Ltd (BZW) has underwritten the rights issue.

The balance of the payment for the Sainsbury and Morrison portfolios and the Huddersfield and Middlesbrough properties will be funded with new banking facilities of up to 45.8 million and from existing resources.
